name: Motorcycle Simulator Mexico
summary:
Ride Mexico City from the seat - alone or with your friends.

30 KM ROUND MEXICO CITY
North on the Circuito Interior from Condesa under Torre Reforma, Torre Mayor and Torre BBVA, east along Rio Consulado, south past the airport to the Palacio de los Deportes and the Autodromo, then west on the Viaducto - seven kilometres of straight.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
